article.intro: Good indie band names take ordinary things and make them sound like a scene: The Wombats, Belle & Sebastian, Snail Mail. This **indie band name generator** makes band names, artist names and album titles in the same spirit, from The Milk Floats to Do You Remember the Lido?

sections.heading: Eight good indie band names
sections.content:
All eight came from the generator:

  • The Milk Floats: "The" and something very British and slightly old-fashioned.
  • The Garden Centres: a dull place, made charming.
  • Library Cards: a small object everyone remembers.
  • Hattie & Humphrey: two old names joined, the way Belle & Sebastian did it.
  • Picnic Department: two words that don't quite belong together.
  • Puddle Motel: a bedroom-project name, odd and memorable.
  • Kettle Palace: something homely made grand.
  • Do You Remember the Lido?: an album title asked as a question.

sections.heading: How indie names work
sections.content:
"Indie" first meant independent: bands on small labels like Rough Trade, Factory and Creation rather than the majors. The Smiths were on Rough Trade. In 1986 the NME gave away a cassette called C86, which gave its name to a whole jangly, homemade scene.

Indie names favour the small and the everyday:

  • The plural: The Penny Arcades, The Postcodes.
  • Two names: Belle & Sebastian named themselves after a French children's story. Here: Edie & Elsie.
  • Two mismatched words: Cardigan Supper, Paper Society.
  • A one-person project that sounds like a band: Biscuit Habits, Pigeon Club.

Choose Artist name for a singer-songwriter like Imogen Tasker or a project name, and Album title for records like The Weather in Our Town or Reasonable Romance.

sections.heading: Using an indie name
sections.content:
• Small and specific wins. A milk float or a lido says more than a big abstract word.
  • Read it on a poster next to three other bands. A good indie name looks right in a festival line-up.
  • Search before you commit. Look the name up on Spotify, Bandcamp and YouTube, and check the social handles are free. Two acts with one name confuse fans and streaming services alike.

For the louder 90s sound, try the Grunge Band Name Generator; for the dreamier one, the Shoegaze Band Name Generator. The Song Title Generator and Album Name Generator finish the job, and the Band Name Generator covers every genre.

faqs.question: What are good indie band names?
faqs.answer: Small, everyday and slightly odd: The Milk Floats, Library Cards, Picnic Department, Hattie & Humphrey or Kettle Palace. The best ones make something ordinary sound like a scene.

faqs.question: Why do so many indie bands start with "The"?
faqs.answer: It's a tradition that runs from the 60s through The Smiths to today: "The" plus a plural noun sounds like a gang. It also makes a name easy to say on stage.

faqs.question: Are these real indie bands?
faqs.answer: No, they're new names in the style of British and US indie. Search Spotify and Bandcamp before you use one, since small bands with the same name are common.
